title: First: ready to send
description: What Gina asked for first, ready on day one: “A list of every estimate over $10,000 that's been sitting unsigned for more than 7 days, biggest dollar amount first, with a short follow-up email drafted to each homeowner by first name. That's where the money is.”
instructions:
Produce “First: ready to send” tonight — What Gina asked for first, ready on day one: “A list of every estimate over $10,000 that's been sitting unsigned for more than 7 days, biggest dollar amount first, with a short follow-up email drafted to each homeowner by first name. That's where the money is.”.

Follow the procedure of the “Third” workflow, using only what is in the knowledge base and memory so far:
1. List everything due for third from JobNimbus — today it works like this: “Every time rain moves in, I'm on the phone reshuffling three crews”.
2. Prepare the draft for each one, in the team's voice, and mark anything you had to assume.
3. Request approval from Gina before anything leaves the business.
4. Deliver one document with a table (item, what was prepared, what needs Gina) at the top.
5. Hard rules from the call, in every draft: “Never mention financing or put a new price in writing — prices only come from me.” “Never contact the Hendersons on Maple Court; Rick Alvarez handles them personally, nobody else talks to them.”

You were hired for: First; Third; Insurance claim packets & supplements; Fourth. Show this first piece of work in the format those workflows will use.

Deliver it as one document. Label any assumption, and list exactly what you still need from the team.
